## Post one idea {#padlet}

::: {.live-board}
Post one thing you learned today.
:::

::: notes
**A Padlet wall on a slide.** The wall fills the slide; the link and its QR code are in the card in the corner: click the QR code (or **Show QR**) to show it big, so students can scan it.

**Posts too big?** The slide shows Padlet smaller than full size (`zoom="0.7"`), so more posts fit. Change it in the file: `::: {.live-board zoom="0.6" src="…"}` (smaller numbers fit more). For a slide with the board and other things on it, add `layout="inline"`.

**Make it ready (once per padlet):**

1. Make a padlet at padlet.com.
2. **Share** › set the privacy so visitors **can write**. Then students post without an account.
3. **Share** › **Embed in your blog or website** › copy the code.
4. On this slide, click **Edit link** and paste the code. It's kept in this browser.

**To keep it in the deck** (for every computer), write the links in the file:

`::: {.live-board src="https://padlet.com/embed/…" join="https://padlet.com/you/…"}`

`src` is the embed address (inside the embed code). `join` is the normal link (**Share** › **Copy link**): that's the link students get. Without `join`, they get the embed address.

Padlet needs the internet, and some school networks block it.
:::

## Draw together: Excalidraw {#excalidraw}

::: {.live-board rooms="excalidraw"}
Scan to draw with us.
:::

::: notes
**Excalidraw** (free, open source). This slide makes a **room** for you. Anyone with the link draws in the same room. No logins.

**Important:** Excalidraw turns off sharing inside a frame, so the slide doesn't show a frame (that would be a second, private board). It shows the room's QR code: students scan it, then click **Open the class board** and show that tab on the screen. Everyone, you included, is then on the same board.

- **New room:** a new, empty room with a new link (for the next class). The old room stays at its old link.
- **Edit link:** paste a room link you made at excalidraw.com (**Share** › **Live collaboration**).
- The room is kept in this browser, for this slide. Students only need the QR code.

Want a shared board **on** the slide? Use the next slide.
:::

## Draw together: on the slide {#whiteboard}

::: {.live-board rooms="wbo"}
Scan to draw on this board.
:::

::: notes
**WBO** (wbo.ophir.dev, free, open source). A shared whiteboard that fills the slide and stays live: what students draw on their tablets shows up here. The QR code, link and **New room** are in the card in the corner.

- The board's name is in its link. Anyone with the link can draw, so make a **New room** for each class.
- Pens, shapes, text and an eraser are on the left. **Clear** wipes the board for everyone.
- Remind students: no names or personal details on a board anyone with the link can open.

All three boards need the internet.
:::
